title: [Cursor Wrap] Add haptic feedback after a completed wrap

status.label: Owned haptics implementation tracker
status.detail: The assigned Cursor Wrap tracker is scoped under #48761 and depends on #50162.

next_action.label: Post completed-transition note
next_action.reason: The tracker intentionally distinguishes a successful wrap from contact with the source edge.

comment.body: This assigned Cursor Wrap tracker should consume #50162 for parent #48761. Please emit one Grow pulse only after the pointer reaches the destination edge of a completed wrap; edge contact that does not wrap must remain silent, and remaining at either edge must not repeat feedback.

judgment.rationale: The issue is already an assigned, narrowly scoped implementation tracker in the haptics feature set.
evidence: The issue is authored and assigned to niels9001.
It references parent #48761 and shared haptics tracker #50162.
Acceptance criteria require one Grow pulse per completed wrap and no feedback for unsuccessful edge contact.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a coordination note preserving the completed-transition semantic and shared dependency.
